protectedFiles: All pre-existing scene bytes, Stalker art/native metadata, ProjectSettings and EmergencyLamp prefab match the task baseline. Unrelated working changes remain outside this commit.
previewScope: poses.png is an isolated native comparison of four poses. corpses.png is a static native art-library render, not a recording of the physics layout. All three actual Play-mode corpse compositions and exact settled checkpoint round-trips passed the runtime checks.
artisticStatus: Implemented for owner evaluation. The separately generated eyeball style was rejected and is not used in production.
compileNote: Six pre-existing obsolete FindObjectsByType/FindObjectsSortMode warnings in unrelated Development/EnvironmentLoadProbe appeared on the first full Editor compilation; final runtime console and release build are clean.
bloodRegistration: Claw marks use anatomical angular ordering and exclude the central attack mouth; opaque area size never assigns stain identity.
